title: Demon Slayer’s Success Continues to Be a Problem for the Anime Industry
content: The Demon Slayer franchise started a chain of events that is negatively affecting the anime industry in many ways, and most of them are bad. Demon Slayer became one of the first anime to produce a movie that adapted canon events from its original source material.

title: Super Dragon Ball Heroes Proves Even The Weakest Saiyan Form Is Powerful
content: Base form used to mean low-level power in the Dragon Ball universe, but with recent content, some fighters are changing the narrative surrounding the term. It started with Dragon Ball Super: Broly , where the Legendary Super Saiyan continued to display obscene levels of power without advancing to his next form .
